results.title: Fuel price volatility pushing consumers toward EVs: AC Mobility CEO - CNBC
results.snippet: Fuel price volatility pushing consumers toward EVs: AC Mobility CEO. AC Mobility CEO Jaime Alfonso Zobel de Ayala says the company trimmed its brand lineup, including Honda and Volkswagen, to focus on building an EV ecosystem. He says consumers are shifting to electric as fuel prices stay volatile, while electricity offers more stable growth.
